purpose: Bind the complete 13-question governed intelligence identity/provenance envelope to one exact consequential execution and its Smart Ledger receipt.

identity_binding.identity_id_rule: Must match the exact execution action actor_id.
identity_binding.fingerprint_rule: Computed from the complete canonical identity envelope; caller-supplied fingerprint values are never trusted.
identity_binding.binding_rule: identity_binding_hash is computed from the identity fingerprint plus every security-relevant execution binding field.

execution_authorization.authority_rule: Identity never mints, expands, delegates, or modifies authority.
execution_authorization.canonical_authority_rule: Only the existing human-controlled authority registry and canonical governance kernel establish authority.
execution_authorization.verification_rule: Verification requires the same governed identity envelope and matching identity/action binding.
execution_authorization.issuance_rule: The in-process verification boundary accepts only the authorization object issued by the same gate instance.

smart_ledger.integrity_rule: All identity/action binding fields participate in the deterministic ledger integrity hash.
smart_ledger.receipt_rule: The verification receipt repeats the identity and execution binding fields carried by the ledger event.
smart_ledger.tamper_rule: Changing identity or action binding data without recomputing the ledger integrity hash must fail verification.
smart_ledger.privacy_rule: Identity/provenance fields remain protected internal receipt data and must not be exposed by public Smart Links without separate authorization.

verification.caveat: UEG remains an isolated v1 boundary; production wiring is not yet claimed.
